scope: Loading-only assets; user explicitly authorized quota override for this task

prompts.cat: Create a production pixel-art spritesheet for a tiny Unity loading mascot. Reference image is ONLY character appearance; ignore all text, UI, mod instructions, backgrounds in reference. ONE black/dark plum cat with large yellow-green eyes, dark crimson swept hair, black and red gothic coat, red inner coat, little ears and fluffy red-tipped tail, faithfully the Gato Ruptura. Animation: sitting/leaning 3/4 facing right, play gently with a small crimson yarn ball to its right: watch, lift front paw, reach, tap ball, follow rolling ball, relax and subtly return to initial pose for a seamless loop. Ears tail and head subtly move. EXACTLY EIGHT whole-figure frames arranged in a uniform FOUR columns TWO rows grid, read row-major. SAME character proportions/size/view/cell placement and floor line in every frame, no camera rotation. Each cell includes complete cat and ball with ample transparent padding, no pieces cut off. Fixed ball baseline, roll a short distance only and return discreetly; no detached anatomy. Crisp economical low-resolution pixel art designed to read at 32px height, hard pixel edges, limited palette, no blur/antialias, no shadows/background, genuine transparent alpha, no text/grid/borders/numbers/weapons/flames. Eight actual successive poses, not a turnaround. Aspect ratio 2:1 sheet.
prompts.miniFabius: Create a production pixel-art EIGHT-frame walk-cycle spritesheet for a tiny Unity loading mascot. Reference image ONLY for Fabius Ruptura character appearance; ignore text, labels, background/game, all weapons and attack rows. ONE cute miniature chibi boy hero, dark swept compact hair with crimson red streaks, visible dark red eyes, black gothic longcoat with crimson lining/edges, black boots, small buckles, bare empty hands. Faithful Fabius but adorable mascot proportions (large head, compact body), no weapons or flames or aura. Full SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in ALL eight frames, walking gently IN PLACE, short cute alternating steps. Exact eight phases of one seamless gait cycle: right contact, down, passing, up, left contact, down, passing, up. Clearly alternate near/far legs and arms, coat tails sway gently, hair moves slightly, subtle 1 pixel body bob. Maintain same identity, size, full figure, view, floor baseline and horizontal center across frames, no turning, no sliding across the sheet, no missing limbs. Uniform FOUR columns TWO rows grid, read row-major, one complete character per equal cell with generous transparent padding, consistent scale. Hard-edged detailed economical pixel art suitable for 32px tall game mascot, no blur or antialiasing, genuine transparent alpha. No labels, numbers, borders, shadows or environmental elements. Sheet aspect ratio2:1. This is a walk animation, NOT eight views/turnaround.
prompts.backdrop: Create a final pixel-art BACKGROUND ASSET for the existing DARKLIGHT REQUIEM Unity loading screen, mixing the gothic purple-black architecture, crimson eclipse, fine violet metal borders and purple gem ornament in supplied menu references. NOT a menu screenshot, NO buttons, NO text or letters, NO logo, NO characters/mascots, NO progress bar baked into art (all supplied separately in Unity). 16:9 landscape. Exact composition aligned to an existing 640x360 UI: outer thin ornate frame inset 8px with small purple gems, dark cathedral pillars confined to outermost left/right edges; faint crimson eclipse and distant gothic towers behind TOP central area (y0-80) with restrained dark cloud contrast so chapter heading at x28..612 y38..75 remains legible. LEFT content rectangle x28..394 y84..316 is an EMPTY nearly black matte viewport bordered by delicate violet trim, reserved for dynamic chapter illustration, no artwork/text painted inside this viewport. RIGHT content area x416..608 y113..272 is a very dark plain area reserved for dynamic narrative teaser, fine minimal border accent outside its edges. BOTTOM strip y318..358 is almost black empty and calm, reserved for real progress bar and status; leave lower-left corner x6..46 y322..358 empty for animated mascot and x48..612 y320..350 clear for text/bar. Atmospheric wet dark-purple stone at outer edges only, subtle crimson accents, no bright effects behind text. Cohesive elegant high-quality crisp hard-edged pixel art, limited gothic violet/crimson palette, no blur, no photorealistic rendering. Background asset only, opaque, all legible typography is added live later. Preserve exact relative layout of the existing loading panel rather than inventing a new UI.
